_doc: Shared reference dimensions (metres) for stage A assets, the forklift fitting proxy and stage B calibration checks. 'source' says where each number comes from; 'confidence' is high for published specs, medium for values measured from cam01 and accepted by the user.

lsp.source: MoGe-2 measurement on cam01 single sheets; user confirmed reasonable 2026-10-01; thickness is the user's estimate

skid.source: existing skid asset, fitted to cam01 crops

AKH.source: IATA ULD standard (LD3-45); verify against site containers

PMC.contour: flat pallet, net-covered load; lower-deck height shown

PAG.contour: flat pallet, net-covered load; lower-deck height shown

sumitomo_quapro_2t5_dual._tyre_note: radii/widths derived from tyre sizes; dual pair placed from overall_width_dual (the published dual tread does not reconcile with it)
sumitomo_quapro_2t5_dual.source: Sumitomo NACCO QuaPro catalogue (11FD25PAXIII); model identified from cam01 video, user confirmed design; 2.0 vs 2.5 t not confirmed (2.0 t has 0.92 m forks)
sumitomo_quapro_2t5_dual.confidence: high for spec, medium for model match
